name: Anthracite
description: This subclass comprises anthracite, a high rank hard, lustrous black coal destined primarily for residential and industrial (as steel making) or commercial applications. It has generally less than 10% volatile matter and a high carbon content (about 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

name: Bituminous coal
description: This subclass comprises coking or metallurgical coal and other bituminous coal. Bituminous coal is a medium rank coal used for gasification, industrial coking and heat raising, and residential heat raising. It is characterized by higher volatile matter than anthracite (more than 10%) and lower carbon content (less than 90% fixed carbon). Its gross calorific value is equal to or greater than 24,000 kJ/kg, on an ash-free but moist basis.

name: Sub-bituminous coal

Fresh cannabis refers to fresh or water-rich flowering tops (buds) and leaves, of female plants, that have not been subjected to any drying process.

Cannabis concentrates refer to derived extracts containing concentrated amounts of the psychoactive compound tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), cannabidiol (CBD), and a multiplicity of other cannabinoids and terpenes.

name: Prefabricated metal buildings and components thereof
description: This subclass comprises prefabricated industrial, commercial, and institutional buildings, predominantly made of metal, and their components, except manufactured (mobile) buildings. Prefabricated (factory-built) metal buildings are virtually complete and unassembled; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings, and delivered to the construction site. Components of buildings are built in a factory to be assembled later at a construction site. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

name: Prefabricated wood buildings
description: This subclass comprises prefabricated buildings predominantly made of wood, except manufactured (mobile) buildings. Prefabricated (factory-built) buildings are built in a factory or manufacturing facility; they are virtually complete and unassembled; they can also be incomplete buildings, whether or not assembled, having the essential character of factory-built or prefabricated buildings, and delivered to the construction site. Prefabricated buildings can be used for residential or non-residential purposes.

name: Manufactured (mobile) homes
description: This subclass comprises manufactured (mobile) homes. They refer to prefabricated (factory-built) mobile homes of any material, in full, although some manufacturers offer these homes in two sections. Manufactured (mobile) homes are fully assembled when they leave the factory, often ready to move in the same day or few days after arriving on the site. They can be relocated although most homes are never moved from their original site.

name: Non-residential manufactured (mobile) buildings

They refer to prefabricated (factory-built) non-residential mobile buildings of any material, in full, although some manufacturers offer these buildings in two sections. Manufactured (mobile) non-residential buildings are fully assembled when they leave the factory, often ready to move in or use the same day or few days after arriving on the site. They can be relocated.

description: This subclass comprises medical appliances and supplies, n.e.c.

name: Dental equipment and supplies
description: This subclass comprises dental equipment and supplies.

name: Ophthalmic products

name: Personal safety equipment and clothing
description: This subclass comprises personal safety equipment and clothing.

name: Signs
description: This subclass comprises billboard and other signs.

name: Caskets and other related funeral goods
description: This subclass comprises caskets or coffins, and other related funeral goods which contain human remains.

name: Hand tools
description: This subclass comprises hand tools.

name: Kitchen utensils and cutlery (except precious metal)
description: This subclass comprises kitchen utensils and cutlery, except made of precious metal.

name: Pencils, pens and markers (including parts)
description: This subclass comprises pencils, pens and markers, including parts.

name: Office, school and art supplies, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises office, school and art supplies, n.e.c.

name: Batteries and battery chargers
description: This subclass comprises batteries and battery chargers.

name: Playground, gymnasium and exercise equipment
description: This subclass comprises playground, gymnasium and exercise equipment.

name: Other sporting and athletic goods
description: This subclass comprises other sporting and athletic goods.

name: Infant strollers and children's vehicles
description: This subclass comprises infant strollers and children's vehicles.

name: Non-electronic toys and games
description: This subclass comprises non-electronic toys and games.

name: Electronic toys and games (except game software)
description: This subclass comprises electronic toys and games, except game software.

name: Precious metal jewellery
description: This subclass comprises precious metal jewellery.

name: Cut diamonds (except industrial)
description: This subclass comprises cut diamonds, except industrial.

name: Cut gems (except diamonds), jewellery findings, and metal coins and tokens
description: This subclass comprises cut gems, except diamonds, jewellery findings, and metal coins and tokens.

name: Hollowware, flatware and other articles of precious metal
description: This subclass comprises hollowware, flatware and other articles of precious metal.

name: Costume jewellery and novelties
description: This subclass comprises costume jewellery and novelties.

name: Musical instruments
description: This subclass comprises musical instruments and parts and accessories.

name: Buttons, zippers and other notions
description: This subclass comprises buttons, zippers and other notions.

name: Brooms, mops, dusters, brushes, and painting pads, rollers and accessories
description: This subclass comprises brooms, mops, dusters, brushes, and painting pads, rollers and accessories.

name: Other miscellaneous goods, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises other miscellaneous goods, n.e.c.

name: Children's books
description: This subclass comprises published books for children and young adults (up to age 15), in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Textbooks
description: This subclass comprises published books intended primarily as educational material for students and teachers in formal study programs, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: General reference books
description: This subclass comprises published books intended to be used primarily for general reference purposes and aimed at the public at large, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Professional, technical and scholarly books
description: This subclass comprises published specialized books containing research, advanced knowledge or information used by individuals in the practice of specific occupations or professions, or aimed at the academic and research community, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Trade books
description: This subclass comprises published books of general interest intended for the public at large, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Sheet music and other musical texts
description: This subclass comprises published musical works, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Daily newspapers
description: This subclass comprises general-interest newspapers, published at least four times a week, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Community newspapers
description: This subclass comprises general-interest newspapers, published fewer than four times a week, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Other newspapers
description: This subclass comprises published specialized-interest newspapers, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: General-interest periodicals
description: This subclass comprises published general-interest periodicals and magazines, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Business (including farming) and trade periodicals
description: This subclass comprises published periodicals aimed at business, professional and academic audiences interested in keeping up-to-date with new research and developments in their professions or fields of interest, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Other periodicals
description: This subclass comprises published periodicals, except general-interest, and business and trade periodicals, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Mailing lists
description: This subclass comprises lists of names, addresses, and other contact information created to market or promote to a specific group, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Directories
description: This subclass comprises publications consisting of collections of systematically organized contact information, in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Databases
description: This subclass comprises organized and searchable data sets, except directories and mailing lists, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Consumer publications, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises publications n.e.c. intended mainly for personal or household use, on physical media, and in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Business, trade and professional publications, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises publications n.e.c. intended mainly for business, trade, or professional use, on physical media, and in physical or downloadable formats.

name: Musical recordings
description: This subclass comprises published musical recordings, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Non-musical recordings
description: This subclass comprises published non-musical recordings, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Recorded movies
description: This subclass comprises published recorded movies, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Recorded television programs and videos
description: This subclass comprises published recorded television programs and videos, on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: System and programming software (except commercial use licences)
description: This subclass comprises published system and programming software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of system and programming software
description: This subclass comprises licences for the use of system and programming software or software components to generate revenues.

name: Game software (except commercial use licences)
description: This subclass comprises published game software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of game software
description: This subclass comprises licences to use game software or software components to generate revenues.

name: General application software (except game software and commercial use licences)
description: This subclass comprises published general application software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), on physical media or in downloadable formats.

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of general application software (except game software)
description: This subclass comprises licences to use general application software or software components to generate revenues.

name: Transportation of natural gas by pipeline
description: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of natural gas.

name: Transportation of crude oil by pipeline
description: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of crude oil and pentanes plus, as well as pipeline transportation of crude bitumen.

name: Transportation of refined petroleum products by pipeline (including liquid petroleum gases)
description: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of refined petroleum products, including liquid petroleum gases.

name: Transportation of other commodities by pipeline
description: This subclass comprises transportation by pipeline of other commodities.

name: Road transportation services for general freight
description: This subclass comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles, for goods not requiring climate control, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers. Rental of trucks and other motorized road vehicles with operator or driver, for the transportation of general freight, is included.

name: Transportation of bulk liquids and gases by road
description: This subclass comprises transportation of bulk liquids or gases by road. Covers transportation of bulk liquids and gases that must be temperature-controlled or pressurized.

name: Transportation of climate-controlled boxed, palletized and other packed goods by road (including in intermodal containers)
description: This subclass comprises transportation by road of goods that must be kept within given ranges of temperature and humidity, packed in boxes, crates, sacks, drums, or on hangers, hooks or pallets, and in intermodal containers.

name: Transportation of automobiles and light-duty trucks by road
description: This subclass comprises transportation of automobiles and light-duty trucks by road.

name: Transportation of live animals by road
description: This subclass comprises transportation of live animals by road.

name: Transportation of waste, without collection, by road
description: This subclass comprises transportation of waste, without collection, by road.

name: Transportation of dry bulk by road
description: This subclass comprises transportation of dry bulk commodities by road.

name: Transportation of other goods by road
description: This subclass comprises transportation by road of goods n.e.c. Covers transportation of goods that are not packed, large items, and loose goods that are contained only by the vehicle in which they are carried.

name: Rental of road transportation vehicles with operator, for specialized freight
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of trucks and other motorized road vehicles, with operator or driver, for road transportation of specialized freight.

name: Rail freight transportation services
description: This subclass comprises transportation by rail of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of rail equipment with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

name: Water freight transportation services
description: This subclass comprises transportation by water of bulk liquids and gases in or not in intermodal tank containers; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; climate-controlled or not climate-controlled intermodal containers; automobiles and light-duty trucks; livestock; waste; truck trailers; and all other goods. Rental and leasing services of water vessels with operator or crew, for freight transportation, are included.

name: Air freight transportation services
description: This subclass comprises transportation by air of bulk liquids; dry bulk not in intermodal containers; climate-control or not climate-control boxed, palletized and other packed goods; automobiles and light-duty trucks; and other goods; and transportation of any good into space. Rental and leasing services of cargo or freight aircraft with operator or crew, are included.

name: Household moving services
description: This subclass comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of personal effects and property to be used in a dwelling. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

name: Commercial moving services
description: This subclass comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of furniture, fixtures, equipment and other property, but not stock-in-trade, of stores, offices, museums, institutions, hospitals and other establishments. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

name: Institutional and other moving services
description: This subclass comprises removing from premises, loading, transporting, unloading and moving into new premises of goods requiring special handling and protection, such as objects of art, antiques, pianos, displays and exhibits when not part of a household or commercial move. Goods are of varying shapes and sizes. Covers moving by all modes of transportation. May include packing and unpacking. May include declared value coverage.

name: Air specialty services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of small general-purpose aircraft and helicopters with a crew to perform specialized services.

name: Postal services
description: This subclass comprises delivery of letters and parcels under the terms of a universal service obligation, such as an obligation governing delivery by post offices. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Station-to-station transportation of small packages and documents without tracking
description: This subclass comprises transportation of small packages and documents without tracking of each package and document. Service is typically station-to-station but may be door-to-door. Transportation is provided on passenger buses and trains according to published schedules but departure and arrival times are not guaranteed. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Courier and messenger services
description: This subclass comprises transportation and delivery, by a definite day and possibly by a definite time, of small packages and documents, with tracking of each package and document. Delivery by the scheduled day or specified time may be guaranteed. Small packages usually can be handled by one person without using special equipment. Service is typically door-to-door, although there may be options for the shipper to drop a package off and for the receiver to pick it up, and occasional shippers may have to drop off their packages. Pick-up and delivery outside normal service area or outside normal service hours, and pick-up on demand or on a regular schedule, are covered here. Service may include customs clearance. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service. May include declared value coverage.

name: Neighbourhood delivery of small purchased items
description: This subclass comprises door-to-door transportation and delivery of small purchased and serviced items such as take-out meals, groceries, prescription drugs and dry-cleaned clothes. Service is limited to a specified neighbourhood. Delivery is made immediately after the item is purchased or ordered, or scheduled within a short time. Expected delivery time is made known to the recipient. May include collect on delivery (C.O.D.) service.

name: Urban transit services
description: This subclass comprises passenger transportation operated on a network of regular routes and on regular schedules. Service is centred on an urban area and covers urban and suburban areas and areas from which they draw commuters. Commuter services that primarily carry passengers to and from the urban centre are included. Transportation may involve one or more types of vehicles, such as buses, subways, streetcars, commuter trains and ferries. Passengers are permitted to pay on a per-trip basis, and the fare may be calculated on a zone basis. Covers urban transit services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Local limousine services
description: This subclass comprises local passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation, or without reservation to passengers as they leave an airport or other transportation terminal. In the case of travel from an airport or other transportation terminal, the fee is on the basis of the distance to the destination, calculated on a zone basis; there may be a minimum charge. In other cases, the fee charged is on the basis of the length of time for which the vehicle is reserved; there is normally a minimum length of time and/or a minimum tariff. The vehicle and driver are available to make a series of trips as directed by the customer during the period for which the vehicle has been reserved.

name: Local taxi services and taxi dispatch services
description: This subclass comprises passenger transportation by automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available on demand. The fee charged to passengers is on the basis of distance travelled. Also comprises taxi dispatch services.

name: Interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services
description: This subclass comprises long distance passenger transportation by road, over fixed routes on a regular schedule. Long distance transportation is generally between metropolitan areas. Service is either part of an interurban network and connecting services to other destinations are available or service is intended to serve a particular destination, and is not designed to connect to a network of interurban service. Covers charges for incidental transportation of passenger baggage.

name: School bus services
description: This subclass comprises transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis. Service is operated on regular routes and schedules that are designed to accommodate the home locations of individual passengers. The vehicles used are typically buses but may include smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may include vehicles accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers school bus services whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Long distance passenger transportation by chartered bus
description: This subclass comprises long distance passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

name: Local passenger transportation by chartered bus
description: This subclass comprises local passenger transportation for a specific occasion by road vehicles with sufficient interior height for a person to stand, typically buses but not limousines or taxis, with driver. Service is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only by reservation of the entire vehicle, for which a fee is charged to the party who makes the reservation. The party who makes the reservation may or may not charge the passengers an explicit fee for the transportation. Covers use of vehicles that are accessible to passengers using wheelchairs and other mobility aids.

name: Other long distance passenger transportation services by road (except fixed route)
description: This subclass comprises long distance passenger transportation by luxury automobile, not operated on regular schedules or routes, and available only by reservation. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

name: Shuttle services
description: This subclass comprises passenger transportation operated on regular routes and on regular schedules or on regular routes on an unscheduled but frequent basis. Service is typically between a limited number of pick-up and drop-off points, with no local service for other points along the route; or on a circular route with frequent stops. The service is not part of a network. As many passengers as can be accommodated are carried on a first-come first-served basis. Passengers may or may not be charged a per-trip fee. Covers shuttle service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Other local fixed route passenger transportation services by road
description: This subclass comprises local fixed route passenger transportation service by road except urban transit service, transportation of students between home and school on a regular basis, and shuttle service. Covers employee transportation to work arranged by the employer and operated on regular routes and schedules. Vehicles used are typically buses but may be smaller vehicles such as vans and cars, and may be accessible to people using wheelchairs and other mobility aids. Passengers are not charged a per-trip fee. Covers employee transportation to work whether paid for by passengers or by contracts. Carpool transportation is provided by arranging and administering pools and providing a vehicle to members of each pool in exchange for a monthly fee to cover operating costs. One or more pool members must act as driver.

name: Special needs urban transit services
description: This subclass comprises transportation of passengers who have physical or cognitive impairments that make them unable to use regular urban transit. Transportation is by shared vans, minibuses or automobiles, is not operated on regular schedules or routes, and is available only to registered passengers by reservation. Passengers are transported to and from their individual homes, workplaces and other locations. Passengers are charged a per-trip fee. Covers special needs urban transit service whether paid for by passengers or by contracts.

name: Local shared-ride passenger transportation services
description: This subclass comprises local shared-ride service, that is, local shared passenger transportation operated on request, typically between an airport and homes, offices or hotels specified by passengers. The operator carries as many parties having similar origins or destinations as can be accommodated on each trip.

name: Rental of road passenger transportation vehicles, with operator
description: This subclass comprises rental or operating leasing services of passenger automobiles and light vans with operator or driver, that is, chauffeur-driven car-hire services, wherever delivered, generally supplied on a time basis to a limited number of passengers and frequently involving transportation to more than one destination. Also comprises rental or operating leasing services of buses or coaches with operator or driver for a period of time, not generally dependent on distance. The renter defines how and when the vehicles will be operated, determining schedules, routes, and other operational considerations.

name: Rail passenger transportation services
description: This subclass comprises interurban transportation of passengers by rail.

name: Water passenger transportation services (except rental with operator)
description: This subclass comprises coastal and Great Lakes fixed route passenger transportation services by water; and other passenger transportation services by water.

name: Rental of water transportation equipment with operator
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing services of all types of self-propelled passenger vessels for coastal, transoceanic and inland water transport, with operator or crew.

name: Scheduled air passenger transportation services (except wet and damp leasing)
description: This subclass comprises transportation of passengers by air on a flight operated on a regular basis according to a published timetable.

name: Air passenger charter transportation services
description: This subclass comprises rental and leasing of complete aircraft and crew, for the chartered or non-scheduled transportation of passengers and their accompanying baggage, equipment and supplies. Renters or lessees generally do not have operational control of the flights. Air charter services include air taxi, ad hoc air charter, frequent charter membership and full charter services. Full (public) air charter is a long-term renting of an entire aircraft, usually undertaken by tour operators, that require aircraft on a seasonal basis, but do not have the required infrastructure to operate their own aircraft.

name: Rental and leasing of passenger aircraft with operator or crew (except chartering)
description: This subclass comprises rental and leasing services of passenger aircraft or aircraft suitable for passenger and freight (including helicopters) with operator or crew (wet and damp leasing). A ''wet lease'' is a leasing arrangement whereby one

name: Sightseeing services by rail
description: This subclass comprises services by rail which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment such as steam trains, cog railways and monorails. May include commentary, admission to sights, guided visits, meals or entertainment. Covers dining trips and theatre trips. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

name: Sightseeing services by buses and other ground vehicles
description: This subclass comprises services by buses and other ground vehicles which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment that is an attraction in itself. Covers tours that permit clients to get off and board again when they wish. May include commentary, admission to sights, guided visits, meals or entertainment. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

name: Sightseeing services by water
description: This subclass comprises services by water which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment that is an attraction in itself. May include commentary, admission to sights, guided visits, meals or entertainment. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

name: Sightseeing services by air
description: This subclass comprises services by air which take customers to areas of scenic, historical or cultural interest, and/or use vintage or specialized equipment that is an attraction in itself. May include commentary, admission to sights, guided visits, meals or entertainment. These services are short-duration, not involving overnight accommodation.

name: Road transportation support services
description: This subclass comprises services in support of road transportation, such as access to toll roads; towing services; bus terminal services for intercity carriers; drayage services; and snow removal services for roads, highways and bridges.

name: Maintenance and repair services for automobiles and light trucks
description: This subclass comprises maintenance and repair services for automobiles and light trucks; washing and cleaning services for automobiles and light trucks; and regulatory safety and emissions inspection services for automobiles and light trucks.

name: Maintenance and repair services for motor homes, travel trailers and campers
description: This subclass comprises maintenance and repair services for motor homes, travel trailers and campers.

name: Maintenance and repair services for heavy trucks and buses
description: This subclass comprises maintenance and repair services for heavy trucks and buses; washing and cleaning services for heavy trucks and buses; and regulatory safety and emissions inspection services for heavy trucks and buses.

name: Rail transportation support, maintenance and repair services
description: This subclass comprises rail transportation support services; maintenance and repair of locomotives and rolling stock; and maintenance and repair and related services for railway tracks.

name: Water transportation support, maintenance and repair services
description: This subclass comprises marine facility services; navigational services for marine vessels; marine salvage services; water transportation support services, n.e.c.; maintenance and repair of marine vessels; and marine vessel traffic reporting.

name: Air terminal services
description: This subclass comprises air traffic control and navigation services; fixed base operation (FBO) services; airport operation and administration; and aircraft parking services.

name: Other air transportation support services
description: This subclass comprises other air transportation support services.

name: Aircraft maintenance and repair services
description: This subclass comprises aircraft maintenance and repair services.

name: Freight transportation arrangement services
description: This subclass comprises arrangement of the international or domestic transportation of goods on a fee for service basis. May involve consolidating shipments. May include advising on packing, advising on import and other regulations, preparing documentation for customs and other requirements, arranging for customs brokerage, arranging for storage and distribution, and tracking shipments.

name: Customs brokering services
description: This subclass comprises facilitating the clearance of goods through customs on behalf of the importer or exporter of the goods. Covers preparing documentation related to a shipment, paying duties and obtaining release of goods.

name: Other transportation support services
description: This subclass comprises packing and crating services for transportation or storage; liquefaction and regasification of natural gas; freight loading and unloading services; carpool and vanpool coordination services; and transportation support services, n.e.c.

name: Grain storage
description: This subclass comprises storage and safekeeping of grain.

name: Warehousing and storage services (except grain storage)
description: This subclass comprises storage and safekeeping of goods other than grain.

name: Live animals at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for household pets; and livestock.

name: Oilseeds and grains, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for oilseeds and grains.

name: Nursery stock and live plants, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for nursery stock and live plants. Nursery stock refers to plants intended for planting, including roots, bulbs and tubers. Live plants comprise flowers, trees and bushes, and may be sold cut or in pot.

name: Other farm products at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for leaf tobacco, including stemmed and dried; raw wool, animal hair and silk; animal hides, skins and pelts; and raw farm products n.e.c., except oilseeds and grains.

name: Petroleum and petroleum products, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for crude petroleum oil; automotive fuels; other fuels; lubricating oils and greases; and other petroleum products, n.e.c.

name: Fresh meat and meat products (except canned and frozen), at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for fresh meat and meat products, except canned and frozen.

name: Dairy products (except dried, canned, condensed, and evaporated) at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for dairy products, except dried, canned, condensed, and evaporated.

name: Poultry and eggs, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for eggs in shell; and poultry and poultry products, except canned and frozen poultry products.

name: Fresh fish and other fresh seafood, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for fresh or chilled fish and other fresh or chilled seafood.

name: Fresh fruit and vegetables, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for fresh or chilled fruit and vegetables.

name: Other foods at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for frozen food; snack foods; confectionery; bread and other baked goods, including cookies; coffee and tea; sugar and sugar preparations; and other foods, including other food dry goods, n.e.c.

name: Non-alcoholic beverages (except coffee and tea) at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for non-alcoholic beverages, except coffee and tea.

name: Alcoholic beverages at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for alcoholic beverages.

name: Tobacco products (except raw tobacco) and accessories, and electronic cigarettes, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for tobacco products (except raw tobacco) and accessories, and electronic cigarettes.

name: Clothing and footwear, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for men's clothing; women's clothing; children's and infant clothing; vestments, costumes, and non-binary and gender-neutral clothing; clothing accessories; and footwear.

name: Jewellery and watches, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for jewellery; silverware; watches and watch parts; and costume jewellery.

name: Home furniture and furnishings, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for indoor and outdoor home furniture; window treatments; floor coverings, except ceramic tile and wood flooring; household textile products n.e.c.; tableware, kitchenware, cookware and bakeware; and decorative home furnishings.

name: Household appliances at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for household refrigerators and freezers; household stoves, microwaves, clothes washers, clothes dryers, and dishwashers; and small household appliances.

name: Home entertainment equipment at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for televisions and audio and video equipment; and electronic game consoles and game software.

name: Published products and recorded media (except software), at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for books, magazines, newspapers and other publications, except software; audio recordings; and video recordings.

name: Sports equipment, toys, hobby goods and photographic equipment, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for bicycles; swimming pools and swimming pool supplies, except chemicals; sporting goods and equipment; digital and film cameras; photographic supplies; toys and games, except game consoles and software; musical instruments and accessories; hobby and craft supplies; and fireworks and firecrackers.

name: Pharmaceutical and medicinal products, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for medicines, vitamins, minerals and supplements for human use; veterinary medicines; and biologics, including vaccines and diagnostic substances.

name: Cosmetics and personal care supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for cosmetics and beauty supplies, including perfumes; bath, facial, and hand soaps; disposable diapers, and feminine hygiene products; medical supplies for persons; and other personal care supplies, including non-electric toothbrushes and razors.

name: Automobiles, light trucks, and vans, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for automobiles, light trucks, and vans.

name: Buses, medium and heavy-duty trucks, and truck tractors, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for buses, medium and heavy-duty trucks, and truck tractors.

name: Recreational and other motor vehicles, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for motor homes, travel trailers, and campers; and motorcycles, snowmobiles and other recreational land vehicles, including trailers.

name: Tires and tubes, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for tires and tubes.

name: Other new and used motor vehicle parts and supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for automotive batteries; new motor vehicle parts and accessories; automotive chemicals; and used motor vehicle parts and accessories.

name: Lumber, plywood and millwork, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for hardwood lumber; softwood lumber; wood doors and windows, and other millwork; flooring products of wood, including laminate flooring; and other wood products for construction and renovation.

name: Electrical, lighting and communication supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for electrical motors, and generation and distribution equipment; electrical and communication wire and cable, and electrical system products; alarm and signalling systems; and light bulbs, fluorescent tubes, and flashlights.

name: Plumbing, heating and air-conditioning equipment and supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for plumbing equipment and supplies, including valves; and heating, ventilation and air-conditioning equipment and supplies.

name: Paint, glass and wallpaper, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for paint and painting supplies; original equipment manufacturers coatings; glass and glass products; and wallpaper.

name: Hand tools and hardware, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for power hand tools; hand tools; fastener hardware; and other hardware.

name: Other building supplies at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for concrete, cement, sand, gravel, stone, brick, block and tile; ceramic floor and wall tile; insulation products; non-wood roofing and siding; iron and steel structural materials; wire and cable, except electrical and communication, and wire products; metal doors, windows and trim; metal building materials n.e.c.; and other building materials, n.e.c.

name: Farm and lawn and garden machinery and equipment, and farm supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for farm machinery and equipment; lawn and garden machinery and equipment; parts of agricultural machinery and equipment; animal feed, except pet food; seeds and bulbs; agricultural chemicals; and other agricultural supplies.

name: Construction and forestry machinery, equipment and supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for construction machinery and equipment; forestry machinery and equipment; and parts and supplies for construction and forestry machinery and equipment.

name: Mining and oil and gas well machinery, equipment and supplies, at wholesale
description: This subclass comprises wholesaling services for mining and oil and gas well machinery and equipment; and parts and supplies for mining and oil well and pipeline machinery and equipment.

name: Direct advertising services, sold separately

It covers advertising and marketing campaigns communicated by direct mail, door-to-door delivery, distribution of samples in public places, use of advertising specialties, product demonstrations and display lettering.

name: Full service direct mail advertising
description: This subclass comprises all the services required for a direct mail advertising campaign, from the concept development through the actual mailout (including emailing). Services include implementing a bundle of direct mail advertising methods, such as concept development services for direct mail advertising campaign, letter shop services, selling custom mailing lists and databases for direct mail use, proofreading direct mailout package materials, editing and formatting client-supplied mailing lists and databases for direct mail use, receiving and making telephone calls related to direct mail campaign. Generally, the direct mail advertising service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

name: Full service direct advertising
description: This subclass comprises all services required for developing a comprehensive strategy to send promotional messages directly to consumers, except via mass media. Services include implementing a bundle of marketing or advertising methods, such as telemarketing, distribution of advertising materials and advertising specialties, other than by mail, direct mail, product demonstrations and display lettering. Generally, the direct advertising service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.

name: Full service advertising campaigns
description: This subclass comprises all services required to create a comprehensive advertising campaign and place the resulting advertisements in media. Services include a bundle of advertising services with some or all creative and productive services for advertisements; and planning, buying of time and space and research media services. Generally, the advertising campaign service bundle is sold as a package and provides financial gain for the client.
