description: This subclass comprises the provision of lines of credit to credit card holders, and credit card processing services to merchants, that together enable credit cards to be accepted as a means of payment.

name: Factoring
description: This subclass comprises the provision of financing to a business from the sale of its accounts receivable to a third party, known as a factor. Normally, the factor assumes the full risk of collection, including credit losses.

name: Financial leasing
description: This subclass comprises leases in which the lessor is providing a financial service to enable the lessee to enjoy the benefits of ownership of the leased asset. A lessee has the option of purchasing the machinery and equipment after the lease term has been completed, at an agreed price. With a finance lease the equipment appears on the lessee's balance sheet, as it is viewed as a purchase. Also known as capital lease.

name: Sales financing
description: This subclass comprises the provision of credit by means of conditional sales contracts.

name: Other credit financing products
description: This subclass comprises financing services related to trading and dealing in securities which generally involve the use of securities as collateral or as the lent instrument, as well as other credit financing products, n.e.c.

name: Securities origination products
description: This subclass comprises assisting the issuers of securities (businesses and government) in creating their securities and in having them distributed to the investing public. The service may involve advising the issuer; purchasing securities from the issuer and selling them (underwriting); or acting as an agent in marketing the securities.

name: Brokering and dealing of money market instruments
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing money market instruments, which are fixed-rate of return debt instruments that mature within one year or less.

name: Brokering and dealing of other debt instruments
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing debt instruments other than money market instruments.

name: Brokering and dealing of equities
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing equity securities.

name: Brokering and dealing of derivatives
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing in derivative instruments, which are contracts whose value is based on the value of an underlying entity.

name: Foreign currency wholesale brokering and dealing
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing foreign currencies, on a wholesale basis.

name: Brokering and dealing of investment company securities
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing investment company securities.

name: Brokering and dealing of other financial instruments
description: This subclass comprises brokering and dealing other financial instruments.

name: Brokerage correspondent products
description: This subclass comprises the service consisting of one broker-dealer carrying out trades on behalf of another, where the first broker-dealer has access to a particular securities exchange and the other does not.

name: Personal trust and financial planning services
description: This subclass comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services intended for private individuals.

name: Trust and financial planning services for businesses, institutions, and government
description: This subclass comprises trust services and financial planning and investment management services for businesses, institutions (except unincorporated), and governments.

name: Management of financial market and clearing services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of an infrastructure for trading securities and commodity contracts; and clearing and settlement services for securities, commodities contracts, and payments. Covers trades executed on exchanges or over-the-counter, and clearing and settlement services for those trades.

name: Automated clearing house services
description: This subclass comprises automated funds credit and debit clearing and settlement services.

name: Other products supporting financial services
description: This subclass comprises loan servicing; automated banking machine (ABM) operation products; and other miscellaneous products supporting financial services.

name: Pension and annuity products
description: This subclass comprises underwriting services of plans which provide income payments at regular intervals to individuals or members of groups. Plans may require a single contribution or a series of contributions; may be compulsory or optional; may have nominal benefits determined in advance or dependent on the market value of aspects supporting the plan; and, if related to employment, may or may not be portable with a change in employment. The duration of the period during which benefits are paid may be fixed in terms of a minimum or maximum; there may or may not be survivors' benefits.

name: Life insurance products
description: This subclass comprises underwriting services of insurance policies which provide for the payment of claims to beneficiaries contingent upon the death of the insured individual or upon the maturation of the policy. Policies may provide pure protection or may also contain a savings component. Policies may cover individuals or members of groups.

name: Health insurance products
description: This subclass comprises underwriting services of insurance policies which provide protection for specified expenses not covered by government health insurance programs, as well as underwriting services of insurance policies which provide periodic payments when the insured is unable to work as a result of a disability due to illness or injury.

name: Accident insurance products
description: This subclass comprises underwriting services of insurance policies which provide accidental death and dismemberment insurance, that is, payment in the event that an accident results in death or specified injuries.

name: Vehicle insurance products
description: This subclass comprises underwriting property and casualty insurance policies related to the operation of personal or commercial vehicles. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property, or personal injury.

name: Property insurance products (except vehicle)
description: This subclass comprises underwriting property insurance policies, except those related to the operation of vehicles. These policies provide financial protection against the loss or damage to property.

name: Surety bonds and related products
description: This subclass comprises the sale of surety and related products, in which one party guarantees the performance of a second party vis-à-vis another, thereby establishing a three-party relationship. The three parties are the principal (the party that undertakes the obligation), the surety (the party that guarantees that the obligation will be performed), and the obligee (the party that receives the benefit of the bond if the principal fails to meet the obligation).

name: Other liability insurance products
description: This subclass comprises underwriting insurance policies that insure against financial loss arising from legal liability.

name: Other direct insurance products
description: This subclass comprises travel insurance products, and other miscellaneous direct insurance products.

name: Life, health and annuity reinsurance products
description: This subclass comprises reinsurance services for life and health insurance, and for annuities.

name: Surety bonds and related reinsurance products
description: This subclass comprises reinsurance services for surety bonds.

name: Property and casualty reinsurance products
description: This subclass comprises reinsurance services for property and casualty insurance policies.

name: Other reinsurance products
description: This subclass comprises reinsurance services, n.e.c.

name: Insurance brokerage and agency services
description: This subclass comprises serving as an agent or broker in selling insurance policies or reinsurance contracts.

name: Claims adjustment services
description: This subclass comprises determining the amount, if any, to be paid to an insurance policyholder making a claim under the policy.

name: Insurance consulting services
description: This subclass comprises insurance and actuarial consulting services.

name: Other services related to insurance
description: This subclass comprises services that support the underwriting and reinsuring of insurance policies, n.e.c.

name: Rental of land for residential use
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of land for residential use.

name: Rental of residential space in buildings or other facilities, for use as principal residence
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of space in buildings or other facilities, for use as the principal residence of a household. May include additional facilities, such as parking and recreational amenities.

name: Rooming and boarding services
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of space for use as the principal residence of a tenant in rooming and boarding houses. May include additional services, such as housekeeping, meal and laundry services.

name: Rental of land for non-residential use
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of land for non-residential use.

name: Rental of office and professional space
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of buildings or other space for office and professional use.

name: Rental of commercial space
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of buildings or other space for commercial use.

name: Rental of industrial space
description: This subclass comprises rental or leasing of buildings or other space for use in manufacturing, research, storage, distribution and similar industrial activities.

name: Rental of space in mini-warehouses and self-storage units
description: This subclass comprises rental of storage space which can be accessed directly by the renter.

name: Rental of other non-residential space
description: This subclass comprises rental of space for meetings, conventions, and similar short-term business use; rental of space for weddings, banquets, parties, and similar short-term social use; rental of theatres, auditoriums, stadiums, arenas, and similar facilities; hosting of coin-operated or card-operating machines; and rental of other non-residential space, n.e.c.

name: Brokerage services for the sale and rental of residential real estate
description: This subclass comprises assisting buyers and sellers of individual residential dwellings and associated land, and owners in renting residential buildings or units and associated land, acting in an agency capacity, for a fee or commission.

name: Brokerage services for the sale and rental of non-residential real estate
description: This subclass comprises assisting buyers and sellers of non-residential buildings or other non-residential facilities and associated land, and owners in renting non-residential buildings or other non-residential facilities and associated land, acting in an agency capacity, for a fee or commission.

name: Brokerage services for the sale and rental of vacant land
description: This subclass comprises brokerage services for the sale and rental of vacant land.

name: Real estate consulting services
description: This subclass comprises providing advice and guidance to clients regarding real estate, including advice on accountancy, financing and similar matters. These real estate consulting services are provided to clients independently of general accountancy, financial and similar services.

name: Property management services
description: This subclass comprises management of real estate properties on behalf of property owners.

name: Real estate appraisal services
description: This subclass comprises providing assessments of the value of urban and rural real estate, in order to assist clients in buying, selling, or financing the purchase of real estate, or in dealing with tax matters.

name: Real estate listing services
description: This subclass comprises providing a register of real estate offered for sale in an area, in a printed directory, electronic database or other format.

name: Services provided by real estate agencies to their real estate associates
description: This subclass comprises the services provided by real estate agencies to their real estate associates.

name: Legal services concerning criminal law
description: This subclass comprises providing legal advice concerning the application or interpretation of criminal law; representing clients before courts, administrative agencies, and other official tribunals in such matters; and participating with or on behalf of clients in negotiations and other dealings with third parties concerning the application or interpretation of criminal law.

name: Legal services concerning non-criminal law
description: This subclass comprises providing legal advice concerning the application or interpretation of the law in non-criminal (civil) matters; representing clients before courts, administrative agencies, and other official tribunals in non-criminal law matters; and participating with or on behalf of clients in negotiations and other dealings with third parties concerning the application or interpretation of non-criminal law.

name: Legal support services
description: This subclass comprises patent and trademark office representation services; and legal document filing and search services, process serving services, and notarization and certification services, not bundled with legal services, arbitration or mediation services, or with patent and trademark prosecution services.

name: Auditing and other assurance services
description: This subclass comprises financial auditing services; financial statement review engagements and agreed-upon procedures for financial information; other financial assurance services; and non-financial assurance services.

name: Tax preparation and representation services
description: This subclass comprises services related to tax preparation and representation at audits and appeals for individuals and unincorporated businesses as well as for corporate and other clients.

name: Bookkeeping, financial statement compilation, and payroll services
description: This subclass comprises financial statement compilation services; bookkeeping services; and payroll services.

name: Architectural services for residential building projects
description: This subclass comprises architectural services for residential building projects, including the provision of architectural designs, plans and studies; advisory services; construction documents; and construction contract administration.

name: Architectural services for non-residential building projects
description: This subclass comprises architectural services for non-residential building projects, including the provision of architectural designs, plans and studies; advisory services; construction documents; and construction contract administration.

name: Historical restoration architectural services
description: This subclass comprises architectural services that incorporate legal requirements to preserve or restore the historic character of a building.

name: Architectural advisory services
description: This subclass comprises expert-witness services, and provision of advice, studies and reports, on architectural matters.

name: Landscape architectural services
description: This subclass comprises landscape architectural services for the design of the built landscape, including designs, plans and studies; advisory services; construction documents; and construction contract administration.

name: Urban planning services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of urban planning services that articulate public policies related to land use and development; design the urban environment of buildings, parks and infrastructure networks; create plans for land use; and provide a zoning framework within which plans for specific sites can be developed.

name: Project site master planning services
description: This subclass comprises services consisting in developing plans for a construction site showing the proposed location of buildings, roads, parking lots and other features.

name: Residential building engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to residential buildings.

name: Commercial, public and institutional building engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to commercial, public and institutional buildings.

name: Industrial and manufacturing engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to industrial and manufacturing facilities, processes, and products.

name: Transportation engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to transportation infrastructure.

name: Municipal utility engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to municipal utilities.

name: Power engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to power generating units, power transmission and distribution lines, and related infrastructure.

name: Telecommunications and broadcasting engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to systems for the transmission or distribution of voice, data and programming.

name: Hazardous and industrial waste engineering projects
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services related to systems for the collection, treatment and disposal of hazardous and industrial waste and to systems for the control of pollution.

name: Other engineering projects and engineering advisory services
description: This subclass comprises engineering design services, n.e.c., and engineering advisory services.

name: Drafting services
description: This subclass comprises producing detailed layouts, plans, drawings, illustrations, graphics and models based on engineering or architectural specifications, for use in the design, manufacture, installation, construction, repair or maintenance of buildings, structures, systems or components.

name: Building inspection services
description: This subclass comprises making a visual examination of the components forming a residential or commercial property, making a visual examination of a home during construction, detecting the presence of environmental hazards, making a visual examination of a specific element of a property, and related services, such as making a visual examination of a building for wood-destroying pests or providing expert-witness services.

name: Testing laboratory services
description: This subclass comprises providing conformity assessment services.

name: Project management services
description: This subclass comprises planning, supervising and coordinating the activities involved in carrying out a project, with regard to time, cost, performance requirements, and other constraints.

name: Geophysical data acquisition
description: This subclass comprises the collection of geophysical data (seismic, gravity, magnetic, etc.) for the purpose of characterizing subsurface conditions.

name: Geophysical data processing and interpretation
description: This subclass comprises geophysical data processing and interpretation.

name: Integrated geophysical services
description: This subclass comprises services which cover two or more phases of the process used to carry out geophysical surveys.

name: Other geological and geophysical services
description: This subclass comprises geological and geophysical consulting services; geophysical data sales; and other geological and geophysical services, n.e.c.

name: Geospatial photo and image acquisition, processing and interpretation services
description: This subclass comprises geospatial photo and image acquisition, processing and data interpretation services.

name: Thematic mapping, orthophoto mapping, and charting
description: This subclass comprises preparation and revision of thematic maps, orthophoto maps, and nautical and aeronautical charts.

name: Integrated surveying and mapping services
description: This subclass comprises acquisition of data and information about real property and/or the earth's surface, and the subsequent portrayal of this information in report, map or plan format.

name: Consulting and expert-witness services for geospatial surveying and mapping
description: This subclass comprises consulting and expert-witness services concerning geospatial surveying and mapping.

name: Interior design services
description: This subclass comprises design of interior spaces, in order to meet the physical and aesthetic needs of people, taking into consideration building codes, health and safety regulations, traffic patterns and floor planning, mechanical and electrical needs, and interior fittings and furniture.

name: Interior decorating services
description: This subclass comprises providing aesthetic services associated with interior spaces.

name: Industrial design services
description: This subclass comprises design services that optimize the manufacturing efficiency, functionality and appearance of manufactured goods; and services for the design and fabrication of models of new product concepts. Industrial designs specify such things as the materials, shape and appearance of a good, in order to optimize its ergonomics and aesthetics, and efficiency in the production, use and maintenance of the good. The service is presented in the form of designs, plans, and models.

name: Graphic design services
description: This subclass comprises designing visual communications of businesses and other entities, in order to convey specific messages or concepts, clarify complex information, or project visual identities.

name: Fashion, jewellery and footwear design services, and other design services n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises design services for fashion, jewellery and footwear, and other design services n.e.c.

name: Network design and development services
description: This subclass comprises designing, developing and implementing customers' computer networks.

name: Computer systems design, development and integration services
description: This subclass comprises assessing an organization's informatics requirements, providing advice on hardware and software acquisitions, developing system specifications, and either putting the new system in place or providing the client with the specifications necessary to put the new system in place.

name: Information technology (IT) technical consulting services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of advice or expert opinion on technical matters related to the use of information technology (IT).

name: Information technology (IT) technical support services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of technical expertise to solve problems for the client in using software, hardware, or the entire computer system.

name: Management consulting services
description: This subclass comprises providing advice and guidance on management issues, such as strategic and organizational planning, finance, human resources, marketing and production.

name: Environmental consulting services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of information, advice, and guidance to clients concerning the preservation of air, water and soil quality; natural resource development; waste management; pollution control; and other environmental issues.

name: Economic consulting services
description: This subclass comprises providing advice related to the description and analysis of the production, distribution and consumption of goods and services.

name: Other scientific and technical consulting services
description: This subclass comprises providing advice on soil management, crop and animal production; occupational health and safety; heritage; and other scientific and technical matters n.e.c.

name: Portrait photography services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of photographic portraits of individuals or groups. Portrait photography may be carried out in a studio or in locations such as school auditoriums. Covers still photographs and video recordings, both chemistry-based and digital.

name: Wedding photography services
description: This subclass comprises provision of photography services for weddings and related events such as rehearsal dinners and engagement parties. The services may include the provision of pre-event photographs, such as studio portraits of the bride and groom or the wedding party, in addition to images of the event.

name: Other private special event photography services
description: This subclass comprises provision of photography services for private special events, except weddings.

name: Convention and meeting photography services
description: This subclass comprises provision of photography services for corporate or public special events.

name: Commercial and industrial photography services
description: This subclass comprises provision of photography services for commercial and industrial uses.

name: Veterinary services
description: This subclass comprises prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and health care management services for animals.

name: Alternative dispute resolution services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of alternative dispute resolution services.

name: Marketing research and public opinion polling services
description: This subclass comprises services that provide information about markets for goods and services, and about public opinion.

name: Translation, interpretation and stenographic services, and related services
description: This subclass comprises services for the translation of written material, the interpretation of speech, from one language into another, and the transcription of oral proceedings, in either paper or electronic form, as well as providing captions that can be superimposed on a video showing of a meeting or other event, as the event is taking place. This service is also used to provide a sign language interpretation service to deaf people or to provide a real-time translation.

name: Animal training services for sports and entertainment
description: This subclass comprises animal training or breaking services for sports and entertainment.

name: Other professional, scientific and technical services, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises other professional, scientific and technical services, n.e.c.

name: Office administrative services
description: This subclass comprises providing a range of office administrative services to another establishment. At least some of the services are provided on the premises of that establishment. The services that may be provided include billing, record keeping, personnel, secretarial, mail room, and other administrative activities.

name: Permanent placement
description: This subclass comprises recruiting and referring candidates for permanent (indeterminate) positions for a client, who pays a fee upon successful placement of the employee. The candidate is selected and hired by the client.

name: Contract staffing
description: This subclass comprises finding people to fill positions as independent (self-employed) contractors.

name: Temporary staffing
description: This subclass comprises supplying personnel for temporary work assignments to clients for the purpose of supporting or supplementing the client's workforce in work situations such as employee absences, temporary skill shortages, seasonal workloads, and special assignments and projects. The personnel are employees of the staffing agency but when working are supervised by the client.

name: Temporary staffing to permanent placement
description: This subclass comprises supplying personnel for temporary employment with the expectation of permanent work at the end of a trial period with the client. The employee remains on the payroll of the temporary help staffing firm until the hiring decision is made, at which time he or she becomes an employee of the client or, if not, returns to the temporary help staffing firm.

name: Long-term staffing (payrolling) and co-employment services
description: This subclass comprises supplying personnel for extended work assignments. Under the terms of this arrangement, the client may recruit the person or persons hired by the staffing firm and assigned to the client's place of work, or transfer a portion of the client's existing workforce to the staffing firm. Long-term employees are placed on the payroll of the staffing firm, which is legally responsible for their actions, but when working they are supervised by the client. This service also covers a staffing arrangement in which an organization (i.e., a professional employer organization (PEO)) co-employs a client's workforce. The PEO and the client enter into a contractual agreement whereby the rights and responsibilities in respect of co-employees are shared or allocated, with the service provider assuming responsibility for certain activities as agreed with the client. The services range from basic to full-service packages.

name: Onsite management of temporary help
description: This subclass comprises supplying personnel who, in the work area of the client, assign, co-ordinate, and monitor employees provided by the temporary help staffing firm. This service ensures a single point of contact for the client. Activities include recruitment, testing, selection, training, reporting, and quality monitoring. Assignment of an onsite manager requires a request from the client.

name: Online job listing services
description: This subclass comprises soliciting and posting job openings to a website which may be known as a job board, job bank, recruiting site, directory, labour exchange or employment registry. Organizations that post job listings to these sites are usually charged a fee, whereas job seekers usually have free access.

name: Executive/retained search
description: This subclass comprises recruiting and referring candidates for permanent senior-level positions for a client, who pays a fee that is not contingent upon a successful hiring. The candidate is selected and hired by the client.

name: Other employment services
description: This subclass comprises other employment services.

name: Document processing services, and contract publishing services for others
description: This subclass comprises document preparation services; reprography services; document finishing services; and contract publishing services for others.

name: Mailroom services, mailbox rentals, and mail-presorting services
description: This subclass comprises providing mailbox rental services, mailroom services, such as mail assembly, sorting (including sorting mail by postal code), and delivery to post office, and other processing of mail prior to mailing, such as putting the sorted mail into mail trays.

name: Telemarketing and call support services
description: This subclass comprises making or receiving telephone calls on behalf of others, for such purposes as marketing clients' goods or services, providing customer assistance, and providing answering services.

name: Debt collection, and recovery services
description: This subclass comprises initiating and securing the receipt of payment from delinquent debtors, and retrieving goods put up as collateral for a loan.

name: Seizure and civil execution services
description: This subclass comprises providing services for the seizure of real or personal property in response to or in settlement of a court order or judgment.

name: Credit rating services
description: This subclass comprises providing reports on individuals, businesses or governments containing information on their credit status.

name: Fundraising organization services
description: This subclass comprises preparing and carrying out fundraising campaigns, for others. This also covers support services for live events for fundraising.

name: Other business support services
description: This subclass comprises facsimile transmission services, distance conferencing services, short-term computer rental services, and other business support services n.e.c.

name: Investigation services
description: This subclass comprises conducting investigations to provide information about people, events or documents for use in legal proceedings, pre-employment verification, or domestic matters, or for other uses, about such things as insurance claims and missing persons.

name: Security guard and patrol services
description: This subclass comprises providing protection of people and property using guards and patrols. May include the use of dogs. Patrol officers provide protection to an establishment by patrolling in clearly marked vehicles or on foot, for the purpose of preventing and detecting criminal activity or safety problems such as fires.

name: Bodyguard services
description: This subclass comprises providing personal protection by deterring and preventing hazards to people's security, using specialized personnel (escorts and bodyguards).

name: Armoured car services
description: This subclass comprises providing armoured car transportation of cash and valuables, servicing automatic teller machines, and providing other armoured car services.

name: Building security system monitoring services
description: This subclass comprises monitoring of building alarm and security systems to detect intrusions and other problems. The response to an activated alarm may be notification of official agencies and/or a physical response by the monitoring service. Security systems may monitor for conditions such as fire and flooding, or the status of industrial equipment.

name: Building security system and lock installation and repair services
description: This subclass comprises installation and repair of building locks and security systems, without monitoring services.

name: Vehicle security system and services, and other security system and lock services n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises provision of vehicle security system and services, and other security system services and other lock services n.e.c.

name: Residential cleaning services
description: This subclass comprises cleaning services for residential dwellings. Covers interior cleaning; cleaning on-site and off-site residential carpet, rug and upholstery; and chimney and other specialized dwelling cleaning services.

name: Non-residential cleaning services
description: This subclass comprises cleaning services for non-residential buildings. Covers general-purpose and comprehensive cleaning of rooms and other spaces; building exterior cleaning; on-site and off-site cleaning of non-residential carpets, rugs and upholstery; and disaster restoration and other specialized building cleaning services.

name: Pest extermination and control services
description: This subclass comprises preventing, eliminating or controlling infestations of insects, rodents and other pests.

name: Landscaping services and snow removal services for parking lots and driveways
description: This subclass comprises caring for (including installation and removal) trees, shrubs, plants, lawns or gardens, and ploughing and removing snow from parking lots and driveways.

name: Facilities management support services
description: This subclass comprises provision of a range of services to manage and service facilities which the client uses to carry out its own activity. The services provided are non-core with respect to the client's activity. The range of services provided depends on the nature of the facility, but generally includes administrative and building management services.

name: Other support services
description: This subclass comprises packaging and labelling services; fulfillment services; convention and trade show organization services; and other support services, n.e.c.

name: Water delivered by water works and irrigation systems
description: This subclass comprises water delivered by water works and irrigation systems.

name: Sewage and dirty water disposal and cleaning services
description: This subclass comprises sewage and dirty water disposal and cleaning services.

name: Non-hazardous waste management services
description: This subclass comprises non-hazardous waste and recyclable material collection services (residential and non-residential); non-hazardous construction and demolition waste collection services; destruction services for non-hazardous waste; non-hazardous waste and recyclable material consolidation, storage and preparation services; and non-hazardous waste disposal and facilities operation and maintenance services.

name: Hazardous waste management services
description: This subclass comprises hazardous waste collection services (residential and non-residential); hazardous waste and hazardous recyclable material consolidation, storage and preparation services; hazardous waste treatment services; and hazardous waste disposal and facilities operation and maintenance services.

name: Remediation services
description: This subclass comprises a wide variety of services provided for the remediation of sites whose air, water, and/or soil that has been contaminated by hazardous materials and substances.

name: Physician services
description: This subclass comprises physician services.

name: Other health practitioner services (except physician and dental services)
description: This subclass comprises other health practitioner services, except physician and dental services.

name: Dental services
description: This subclass comprises dental services.

name: Medical laboratory diagnostic and testing services
description: This subclass comprises medical laboratory diagnostic and testing services.

name: Hospital services
description: This subclass comprises hospital services.

name: Ambulance services
description: This subclass comprises transportation of individuals by paramedic or higher level medical personnel staffed ambulance services.

name: Standby, special event, and first aid services
description: This subclass comprises first aid services and standby ambulance services at events.

name: Blood, organ and tissue bank services
description: This subclass comprises collection, processing, storage and distribution of blood, organs, tissues or cells for human use.

name: Other health care services, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises other health care services, n.e.c.

name: Residential care services with skilled nursing
description: This subclass comprises residential care services with skilled nursing care.

name: Residential care services (except with skilled nursing)
description: This subclass comprises residential care services without skilled nursing care but with assistance with daily living.

name: Residential care services with independent living
description: This subclass comprises residential care services for those requiring at most minor assistance with daily living.

name: Rights to occupancy services
description: This subclass comprises complete range of residential care services, over the remainder of the patient's life, in a single facility. There is generally a large initial lump sum payment, and there may be monthly fees as well. A single contract covers the entire arrangement.

name: Social assistance services for children, youth and families
description: This subclass comprises social assistance services for children, youth, and families.

name: Social assistance services for elderly and disabled adults
description: This subclass comprises social assistance services for elderly and disabled adults. These services are non-medical in nature, and do not include long-term residential care.

name: Social assistance services for immigrants and refugees
description: This subclass comprises social assistance services for immigrants and refugees. These services are non-medical in nature, and do not include long-term residential care.

name: Social assistance services for the general population
description: This subclass comprises social assistance services for the general population. These services are non-medical in nature, and do not include long-term residential care.

name: Child day-care services
description: This subclass comprises day-care services for children.

name: Basic education and skills programs
description: This subclass comprises pre-primary, elementary and secondary programs and courses providing a formal basic education for children and adults as well as other programs that provide fundamental knowledge and skills needed by individuals to function productively in society.

name: Trade, career, technical and professional development training programs
description: This subclass comprises programs and courses designed to train, upgrade or for professional development of individuals in the skilled trades or in entry level vocations, career and technical occupation. Programs are generally less than two years in length.

name: Higher career, technical, academic and advanced research qualification programs
description: This subclass comprises programs and courses in higher technical and theoretical subjects which prepare students for further research or for occupations with high skills requirements. Programs are normally two years or more in length.

name: Leisure and recreational instructional programs
description: This subclass comprises programs and courses that focus on the development of an appreciation for and competency in recreational and leisure-related activities. These may result in an award or other form of recognition, but do not qualify for academic credit or career qualifications.

name: Exam preparation and tutoring services
description: This subclass comprises programs and courses designed to prepare individuals to write or undertake academic and professional tests and exams, and tutoring services for students with their course work.

name: Student services
description: This subclass comprises services and support provided to students. Compulsory and supplementary fees may be charged to the students for the services.

name: Other educational support services
description: This subclass comprises educational support services, n.e.c.

name: Education consulting services
description: This subclass comprises advice, consulting and counselling services in educational matters.

name: Sports coaching services
description: This subclass comprises sports coaching services provided to recreational, amateur, professional or semi-professional sports clubs' player athletes.

name: Contract production of live performing arts performances
description: This subclass comprises live arts performances carried out by artists and companies under contract to promoters, venue owners, or others.

name: Contract production of live sporting events
description: This subclass comprises live sporting events at which athletes and teams perform under contract to promoters, venue owners, or others.

name: Contract production of copyrighted works (except live performances and audiovisual works)
description: This subclass comprises works protected by copyright produced under contract to others, except live performances and audiovisual works.

name: Sport and performing arts event organization services
description: This subclass comprises planning, organizing, marketing, and managing live sports or performing arts events on behalf of others, including venue owners and performers. This also covers support services for the production of live sports or performing arts events.

name: Career management and representation services of artists, athletes, entertainers and other public figures
description: This subclass comprises acting on behalf of artists, athletes, entertainers, and other public figures in a wide range of activities that enhance the client's career, including negotiating contracts and bookings for performances and public appearances.

name: Admissions to live sporting events
description: This subclass comprises admissions to attend live sporting events.

name: Admissions to live theatrical (except musical) performances
description: This subclass comprises admissions to live performances of non-musical theatrical artists and companies.

name: Admissions to live musical theatre and opera performances
description: This subclass comprises admissions to live musical theatre and opera performances.

name: Admissions to live symphony and classical music performances
description: This subclass comprises admissions to live performances of symphony orchestras and other classical music artists and orchestras.

name: Admissions to live popular music performances
description: This subclass comprises admissions to live performances of popular music artists and bands.

name: Admissions to live dance performances
description: This subclass comprises admissions to live performances of ballet and other dancers and dance companies.

name: Admissions to live public appearances and speeches
description: This subclass comprises admissions to attend live public appearances and speeches by artists, athletes, entertainers, and other public figures.

name: Admissions to live performing arts performances, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises admissions to attend live performing arts performances, n.e.c.

name: Admissions to Canadian film exhibitions
description: This subclass comprises admissions to exhibitions of Canadian films in cinemas, and other venues such as film festivals, drive-in theatres, and film clubs.

name: Admissions to foreign film exhibitions
description: This subclass comprises admissions to exhibitions of foreign motion picture films in cinemas, and other venues such as film festivals, drive-in theatres, and film clubs.

name: Amusement and recreational services (except live events, heritage institution services, and pleasure craft dockage, launching and utilities services)
description: This subclass comprises golf course and country club services; skiing facility services; fitness and recreational sports centre services; amusement park and arcade services; bowling centre services; corporate and party event services; registration for sports tournaments and matches; and other amusement and recreational services (except admissions to live sporting events, performing arts performances and motion picture film exhibitions, access to heritage institution services, and pleasure craft dockage, launching and utilities services).

name: Pleasure craft dockage, launching and utilities services
description: This subclass comprises the provision of space to dock a pleasure craft at a marina or other facility, for a given period of time; the provision of services to launch a pleasure craft; and the supply of utility services to pleasure craft at marinas.

name: Admissions to heritage institutions
description: This subclass comprises admissions to museums, historic sites, zoos, botanical gardens, and natural areas such as national parks.

name: Travelling exhibits
description: This subclass comprises providing exhibitions to other institutions, for a fee or commission.

name: Public programs of heritage institutions
description: This subclass comprises providing programs to the public that use the facilities and staff of museums, historic sites, zoos, botanical gardens and natural areas, to explain or expand upon the collections, exhibits or sites of the institution.

name: Lotteries
description: This subclass comprises wagers on games of chance in which prizes are awarded randomly to participants who buy tickets.

name: Table wagering games
description: This subclass comprises making wagers on table games operated by one or more live dealers like a croupier or poker dealer.

name: Gambling machine products
description: This subclass comprises making wagers on games of chance by means of electronic and mechanical gambling machines controlled by the gambler, such as slot machines and video lottery terminals.

name: Racing and sporting event gambling products
description: This subclass comprises making wagers on sporting and other future events.

name: Internet gambling products
description: This subclass comprises making wagers on games of chance interactively on Internet sites.

name: Meals and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and served with table service
description: This subclass comprises meals, snacks, other food items and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and served for immediate consumption, on the premises at a bar, table, or other place attended by a server.

name: Meals and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and dispensed without table service, for consumption on the premises
description: This subclass comprises meals, snacks, other food items, and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared for immediate consumption, on the premises at a table or other place not attended by a server.

name: Meals and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and dispensed for immediate consumption off the premises
description: This subclass comprises meals, snacks, other food items, and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and dispensed for immediate consumption off the premises.

name: Meals and non-alcoholic beverages for immediate consumption, prepared under long-term contract
description: This subclass comprises meals, snacks, other food items, and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and served or dispensed, for immediate consumption, under contract for a specified period of time, to a business, government or institution, which pays the food preparer.

name: Meals and non-alcoholic beverages prepared for catered events
description: This subclass comprises meals, snacks, other food items, and non-alcoholic beverages, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption at unique events, under contract with the caterer.

name: Wine and wine drinks, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption
description: This subclass comprises wine or wine mixed with other ingredients, except distilled spirits, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption in opened containers or glasses. Beverages may be served at a bar or a table.

name: Beer, ale, and malt beverages, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption
description: This subclass comprises beer, ale, or malt beverages, pure or mixed with other ingredients, except distilled spirits, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption in opened containers or glasses. Beverages may be served at a bar or a table.

name: Drinks with distilled spirits, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption
description: This subclass comprises distilled spirits, served straight or mixed with other ingredients, prepared and served or dispensed for immediate consumption in opened containers or glasses. Beverages may be served at a bar or a table.

name: Room or unit accommodation services for travellers
description: This subclass comprises temporary accommodation for travellers and others, typically comprising rental of a room with bed.

name: Recreational vehicle park and recreational camp services
description: This subclass comprises temporary accommodation for travellers and others in recreational vehicle parks and recreational camps.

name: Reservation services for passenger transportation (except for cruises)
description: This subclass comprises arranging passenger transportation (except cruises) for travellers, for a commission paid by the transportation provider.

name: Reservation services for cruises
description: This subclass comprises arranging cruise trips for travellers, for a commission paid by the cruise operator.

name: Lodging reservation services
description: This subclass comprises arranging lodging for travellers, for a commission paid by the lodging provider.

name: Reservation services for pre-packaged tours
description: This subclass comprises the services of reserving pre-packaged tours for travellers, for a commission paid by the tour operator.

name: Event reservation and access to global distribution systems
description: This subclass comprises event ticket sales and reservation services; and access to global distribution systems.

name: Trip planning services
description: This subclass comprises provision of assistance to travellers by advising them on travel matters, obtaining visas, and making reservations and similar arrangements, for a fee paid by the traveller.

name: Packaged tours
description: This subclass comprises packaged tours, which typically comprise accommodation, most transportation, some or all meals, and the services of a tour guide.

name: Other travel arrangement and reservation services
description: This subclass comprises other travel arrangement and reservation services.

name: Hair care and aesthetic services
description: This subclass comprises hair care services; nail care services; and skin care services.

name: Funeral services
description: This subclass comprises pre-burial services for human remains; cremation of human remains; interment of human remains; graves, plots, and other spaces for human remains; cemetery maintenance services; and packaged funeral services for human remains.

name: Laundry, dry-cleaning and steam pressing services (except commercial and agency services)
description: This subclass comprises providing laundry, dry-cleaning and steam pressing services (except commercial and agency services).

name: Commercial and agency services for laundry, dry-cleaning and related services
description: This subclass comprises providing commercial and agency services for laundry, dry-cleaning and related services.

name: Seasonal apparel and textile storage services
description: This subclass comprises providing seasonal storage services for apparel and textiles. May include provision of, or agent services for, laundry or dry-cleaning prior to storage.

name: Parking services
description: This subclass comprises providing parking space for automobiles, motorcycles and bicycles, both on-street and off-street.

name: Non-medical care services for pets
description: This subclass comprises providing non-medical care to pets.

name: Photo finishing services
description: This subclass comprises providing photo finishing services. These cover developing negatives, printing, re-sizing, and other effects, applied to film or digital photos.

name: Hair removal services
description: This subclass comprises removing hair, permanently or temporarily, from the head, face or body.

name: Tattoo, tanning and other body modification services
description: This subclass comprises providing non-medical services that modify the body's appearance.

name: Weight loss services
description: This subclass comprises providing non-medical services to assist clients in attaining or maintaining a desired weight.

name: Non-therapeutic massage services
description: This subclass comprises providing massage services, including manipulation of the skin, muscles and joints, for relaxation or entertainment purposes.

name: Other personal services
description: This subclass comprises services for individuals, n.e.c.

name: Babysitting services
description: This subclass comprises purely custodial care of children, carried out in private residences.

name: Private household services (except babysitting)
description: This subclass comprises private household services, except babysitting.

name: Labour organization services
description: This subclass comprises provision of services by labour unions, bargaining associations and trade unions to members, in exchange for union dues and similar payments. Membership in a labour union confers various rights upon the member, for example relating to election of officers and bargaining, and expresses support for the goals of the labour union.

name: Political organization services
description: This subclass comprises provision of services such as information dissemination, public relations and similar services by political parties.

name: Religious organization services
description: This subclass comprises provision of services by religious organizations to members, in exchange for membership dues and similar payments.

name: Social advocacy organization services
description: This subclass comprises provision of advocacy services promoting a particular social or political cause, on behalf of members, in exchange for membership dues and similar payments. Membership in an organization confers various rights upon the member, for example relating to decision-making within the organization, and expresses support for its goals.

name: Civic and social organization services
description: This subclass comprises provision of services by civic or social organizations to members, in exchange for membership dues and similar payments. Membership in an organization confers various rights upon the member, for example relating to decision-making within the organization, and expresses support for its goals.

name: Business, professional and other membership organization services
description: This subclass comprises business and professional association membership services; performing arts society and club membership services; museum, historical site, zoo, botanical garden and natural area organizations membership services; and services of other membership organizations, n.e.c.

name: Defence services
description: This subclass comprises the defence services provided by the Canadian Armed Forces and civilian agencies.

name: Federal protective services
description: This subclass comprises the federal government services of ensuring the security of persons and property.

name: Federal labour, employment and immigration services
description: This subclass comprises services for labour, employment, immigration, citizenship and other related fields provided by the federal government.

name: Foreign affairs and international assistance
description: This subclass comprises the federal government services of foreign affairs and international assistance.

name: Other federal government public administration services
description: This subclass comprises services provided by the federal government with respect to executive and legislative activities; fiscal and related policies and the administration of the public debt; assessing, levying and collecting taxes; conducting relations with other levels of government; and the administration of federal programs.

name: Provincial and territorial protective services
description: This subclass comprises the services of provincial and territorial governments of ensuring the security of persons and property.

name: Provincial and territorial labour and employment services
description: This subclass comprises services of provincial and territorial governments in labour market research and matters pertaining to employer-employee relations, including the promotion of improved working conditions and the provision of arbitration and conciliation services in collective bargaining.

name: Other provincial and territorial government public administration services
description: This subclass comprises services provided by provincial and territorial governments with respect to executive and legislative activities; fiscal and related policies and the administration of the public debt; assessing, levying and collecting taxes; conducting relations with other levels of government; and the administration of provincial and territorial government programs.

name: Municipal and other local protective services
description: This subclass comprises the services of municipal and other local governments of ensuring the security of persons and property.

name: Municipal and other local public administration services, n.e.c.
description: This subclass comprises services provided by municipal and other local governments with respect to executive and legislative activities; planning; fiscal and related policies and the administration of the public debt; assessing, levying and collecting taxes; conducting relations with other levels of government; and the administration of municipal and other local government programs.

name: Indigenous public administration services
description: This subclass comprises the range of services provided by Indigenous governments to their constituents, services that would otherwise be provided by federal, provincial/territorial or municipal levels of governments.

name: International and other extra-territorial public administration services
description: This subclass comprises governmental services provided by foreign governments in Canada.
